nom: La Roche-Posay Toleriane Moisturizing Milky Cleanser

segments.oily: One reviewer explicitly says the milky formula is more nourishing than oil-controlling and is not suited to oily skin, while another with oily, sensitive skin that dries out in winter reports good results.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including some managing rosacea or medication-related dryness, consistently report the cleanser hydrates without stripping and leaves skin soft rather than tight.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, which turns drier or oilier by season, report it works well though a few say it suits the drier parts of the face best.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin report gentle cleansing with no irritation or breakouts, and one notes a significant reduction in redness.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her forties with mature, slightly dry skin reports it cleans without dryness or tightness.

concerns.dehydration: Reviewers overwhelmingly report the cleanser leaves skin hydrated, soft, and never tight or stripped, even those with very dry skin from medication or winter weather.
concerns.redness: A few reviewers with sensitive or reactive skin report a reduction in redness and irritation after switching to this cleanser.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with a reactive or compromised skin barrier report the cleanser cleans without triggering further irritation and helps keep skin calm.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report no breakouts, though one reviewer says the product felt like a clogging layer and caused breakouts where she normally doesn't get them.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer explicitly notes the formula is nourishing rather than oil-controlling and is not suited to oily skin.

aspects.libelle: Milky, non-foaming texture many find soothing
Doesn't fully remove makeup or sunscreen alone
Leaves a slight film or oily residue for some
Large bottle, good value for the price

extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really wanted the like this cleanser because the concept is great, but it didn't work for me. I personally prefer the foaming cleanser since it makes me feel like my skin is truly clean. This one doesn't foam at all and the texture feels more like a moisturizer. After rinse, my face oily instead of fresh. Even I don't have breakout after use this but I feel it does not work well as cleanser. Unfortunately, as this price, I wouldn't recommend it.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This milky cleanser is extremely gentle and ideal for sensitive skin. It helps cleanse the skin without causing irritation or discomfort. I noticed a significant reduction in redness, and it never left my skin feeling tight or stripped. In terms of hydration, it leaves the skin feeling soft, calm, and moisturized after every use. The formula is effective yet mild, making it suitable for daily use. A small amount goes a long way, so the product lasts quite a while, even with regular use. I use it once to twice daily, and it maintains my skin barrier without triggering irritation. Overall, it's a reliable, soothing cleanser for anyone dealing with sensitive or reactive skin. Gentle and soothing cleanser that reduces redness and irritation while keeping the skin hydrated. A small amount goes a long way, so the product is long-lasting and perfect for daily use without leaving the skin dry or tight.

extraits.auteur: Great for super super dry skin
extraits.texte: I have rosacea and incredibly dry skin. I needed something super gentle on the skin and non drying. It works great for me but I can see this feeing super heavy and oily for those who dont have dry dry skin. It is also very milky not sudsy when cleansing and I normally dont like that but it helps with my dry skin so I dont mind. I also feel like it doesn't remove sunscreen/ makeup well enough on its own so I use another to do that. Unfortunate but stronger cleansers dry my skin out too much so it is what it is.

extraits.titre: The his is a must buy for mature skin that is slightly dry!
extraits.texte: I love the fact my face feels clean but not dry or tight! Love the ingredients! Gentle but effective!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I absolutely love this. I have VERY dry skin due to meds, and genetics. This is so good. I can feel that my skin isn't stripped after washing. I also have very sensitive skin, and this doesn't cause any breakouts. The bottle is also massive. I have been using it daily for a month and the bottle is totally full. The pump is super convenient too. Really good and hydrating, perfect for sensitive dry skin girlies like me!
